name: workflow_node_catalog
description: List the live set of workflow node types supported by the runtime, with their description, category, required fields, edge constraints, and a default-config JSON skeleton. Use this before designing a workflow to see exactly which node kinds exist — the result reflects the runtime's node registry directly, so it never goes stale. For the 'tool' node type, use tool_list/tool_get to discover available action_ids.

type.description: Limit the catalog to a single node type ID (e.g. "tool", "for_each"). Omit to list all node types.
